## Read this first

This is a documentation-only patch release. **There are no code behaviour
changes**: the only edits under `src/` are docstrings and the brand name in
messages.

Nothing about the limits stated for 0.7.0 has changed. **The de-identification
benchmark on i2b2/n2c2 still has not been run.** Every de-identification number
published is on a **synthetic** corpus - a regression gate, not evidence of
real-world accuracy. The default `DeidEngine` does **not** detect names or
street addresses; enable the opt-in NER recognizer for those.

## What is new since 0.7.0

- **New home: openbtk.ai.** The project website and documentation moved to
  openbtk.ai; the docs are at https://openbtk.ai/openbtk-core/. The old
  openbtk.org domain is being retired. The package metadata now includes a
  `Documentation` URL, so it appears on the PyPI page.
- **Brand text** restyled from "OpenBTK" to "Openbtk" in docs, docstrings and
  messages. Class names such as `OpenBTKError` are unchanged.
- **README**: a logo header that shows correctly in light and dark themes on
  both GitHub and PyPI, a tagline, centred badges, and stale version claims fixed.

Full details: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/openbtk/openbtk-core/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
